answer: Each agent identity enters fable, a state tree, only after a TPM/SGX enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation bound to code, key, and hardware nonce; mesa, the consensus contract, verifies it and commits the identity root to an anchor hash. Forging requires controlling distinct physical silicon and breaking enclave isolation or the proof. Registration bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, with failed identities irreversibly slashed.
